pairs.summary: Tcf12 and ZNF549 motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 2 of 14 profiles analysed (K562 chronic myelogenous leukemia; Zhang2021 hepatic tissue | Endothelial (Exocrine Tissues)). Median lift 1.65x, typical spacing ~51 bp between sites. In 2 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction. Evidence: motif co-occurrence only (ChromBPNet not yet run for this pair).
